events.comment: Leaf_Ranger_Boss: the Leaf Ranger fight. The scene links Player_Movement and Combat_Shared before this sheet. He keeps his distance and fights with a fixed rotation of attacks per phase (RotP1, RotP2), plus reactions: a stab when the player is close, an escape slide or a leap over when crowded, a dodge roll on every DodgeEvery-th nearby swing, and a thorn wall after WallHits quick hits.
Scene start: set his speed and start his timers. He waits a moment in Intro before fighting.
His state clock: StateT counts the seconds since the current state or step started.

Keep the enemy bars just above his head. His frame is 288x128 with the body in the lower middle, so the bars follow his head, not the frame top. Raised 22 px, about a quarter of his height, so they clear his face.
The player is gone: stand idle.
Final death: play the death animation and leave the body on its last frame. Arrows in flight and thorns are cleared.
Safety net: no lives left, but he is not in his death state, so die now.
Lost a life: leap to the far side of the arena, hold a pose, then start phase 2. He cannot be hit during this.
Player on the left half: land on the right.
Player on the right half: land on the left.

Posture broken: cancel everything and kneel. He can always be hit while kneeling, even if the break came during a thorn wall or another move that made him invulnerable. Combat_Shared runs the stun and the deathblow.
Stun over: get up and carry on. A deathblow that took a life is handled by the lost-life event above.
A lunge landed: flinch, unless he is in the air, stunned, leaping or dead.
Dodged a swing: roll away from the player.
Dodge decision: every DodgeEvery-th swing near him, while he is standing in Neutral and the dodge is off cooldown, he dodges it. No randomness, so it can be learned.
This is the swing he dodges.
Count the player's hits for the thorn wall. Hits more than WallWindow seconds apart start the count over.
Hits too far apart: start the count over.
Remember his HP for the hit count next frame.
Thorn wall: WallHits quick hits while he is on the ground and the wall is off cooldown. He cancels what he is doing and grows vines in front of him.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Intro: after a moment, start fighting.
Neutral: face the player.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Neutral, the player is rooted after an entangle or a snare: slide straight in and stab, ignoring the stab cooldown.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
The root ended before he could use it: forget the punish.
Overgrowth, once in phase 2 below OverHP percent HP: he leaps to the edge farther from the player and cannot be hit until it is over.
Player on the left half: go to the right edge.
Player on the right half: go to the left edge.
Neutral, player close: stab when it is off cooldown.
Neutral, player crowding him: escape. Slide away if there is room behind him, otherwise leap over the player.
Room behind him: slide away from the player.
Moving right: face right.
Moving left: face left.
Cornered: leap over the player and land LeapLand past them.
Neutral: when the action delay for this phase is over, take the next attack from the rotation.
Phase 1: wait ActionDelayP1, then read the next code from RotP1.
Phase 2: wait ActionDelayP2, then read the next code from RotP2.
Code S: Shot.
Code E: Entangle shot.
Code P: Poison shot.
Code R: Arrow rain.
Code A: Air volley.
Code B: Beam.
Code D: delayed shot. He holds the full draw for ShotHold seconds before letting go.
Code X: double shot. Two arrows ShotGap seconds apart, so the second one needs a chained deflect.
Neutral, player far away: run toward them.
Player to the right.
Player to the left.
Neutral, at a good distance: stand.
Delayed shot: on frame 9, at full draw with the rings glowing, hold for Hold seconds.
Delayed shot: the hold is over, so let go.
Shot: on frame 11 the arrow leaves the bow. A delayed shot holds before this (below), and a double shot sends its second arrow ShotGap seconds later.
Double shot: ShotGap seconds after the first arrow, the second one.
Create an arrow at the bow when one is asked for. Its kind sets its damage and colour.
Damage by kind: a normal shot.
Damage by kind: entangle, tinted green.
Damage by kind: poison, tinted purple.
Facing right: the right-facing arrow.
Facing left: the left-facing arrow.
Shot finished: back to Neutral, and the action delay starts now.
Stab: frames 5 to 7 thrust the arrow forward. A melee hitbox covers 160 px in front of him for that time, so a deflect costs him posture.
Stab finished: back to Neutral and start the stab cooldown.
Arrow rain: on frame 9 the volley goes up. Mark where the player is now. Phase 2 sends a second rain RainGap seconds later, wherever the player is then.
Arrow rain: RainDelay seconds after the volley, the arrows come down at the marked spot.
Arrow rain, phase 2: RainGap seconds later, a second rain at the player's new spot.
Arrow rain finished: the volley animation is over and every rain has been sent.
Rain: from frame 5, while the arrows hit the ground, it hurts anyone under it once. The hitbox covers the patch from the ground up.
Rain: remove it when its brambles have faded.
Air volley: rise AirHeight over AirRise seconds.
At the top: shoot.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Air volley: on frame 6, three diagonal arrows at different speeds, so they land in a spread toward the player.
Create the three arrows at the bow.
Give each its speed and direction.
Right-facing arrow.
Left-facing arrow.
Air volley: shot done, fall back down.
Air volley: falling, over AirFall seconds.
Landed: back on the ground and back to Neutral.

Beam: the crouch and the growing green star on frames 3 to 9 are the tell. On frame 9 the beam fires across the whole arena at chest height: three beam segments and one hitbox to the wall. Roll through it or deflect it.
Create three segments from the edge of his frame.
Line them up end to end.
Beam to the right.
Beam to the left.
Beam: remove the segments when they fade.
Beam finished: back to Neutral.
Thorn wall: from frame 6 the vines are up. Anyone attacking into them, 100 px in front of him, takes WallDamage once. He cannot be hit until the vines start to pull back.
Thorn wall: the vines pull back on frame 15, so he can be hit again.
Thorn wall finished: he stays open for WallOpenTime seconds. This is the punish window.
Punish window over: back to Neutral.
Slide: move away at SlideSpeed until SlideDist is covered or the arena edge is reached, then slow down.

parameters: clamp(Leaf_Ranger.X() + Leaf_Ranger.Variable(MoveDir) * Leaf_Ranger.Variable(SlideSpeed) * TimeDelta(), Leaf_Ranger.Variable(ArenaMinX), Leaf_Ranger.Variable(ArenaMaxX))

events.comment: Entry done: keep sliding in the loop.
Far enough, or at the edge: come out of the slide.
Punish slide: slide toward the player at SlideSpeed.

parameters: clamp(Leaf_Ranger.X() + Leaf_Ranger.Variable(Facing) * Leaf_Ranger.Variable(SlideSpeed) * TimeDelta(), Leaf_Ranger.Variable(ArenaMinX), Leaf_Ranger.Variable(ArenaMaxX))

events.comment: Entry done: keep sliding in the loop.
In range: stab.
The player broke free first: stop and go back to Neutral.
Snare trail: every TrapGap px of an escape slide, up to TrapCount times, he leaves a root trap behind him.
Sliding right: trap facing right.
Sliding left: trap facing left.
Slide finished: face the player again.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Dodge roll: move away at RollSpeed for the length of the roll.

parameters: clamp(Leaf_Ranger.X() + Leaf_Ranger.Variable(MoveDir) * Leaf_Ranger.Variable(RollSpeed) * TimeDelta(), Leaf_Ranger.Variable(ArenaMinX), Leaf_Ranger.Variable(ArenaMaxX))

events.comment: Roll over: back to Neutral.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Flinch over: back to Neutral.
Leap: an arc from FromX to ToX over LeapTime seconds, LeapHeight high, facing the way he jumps.

parameters: Leaf_Ranger.Variable(GroundCY) - Leaf_Ranger.Variable(LeapHeight) * 4 * min(1, Leaf_Ranger.Variable(StateT) / Leaf_Ranger.Variable(LeapTime)) * (1 - min(1, Leaf_Ranger.Variable(StateT) / Leaf_Ranger.Variable(LeapTime)))

events.comment: Moving right: face right.
Moving left: face left.
Landed: back on the ground, facing the player.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Back to fighting: stand.
Between phases: hold the pose.
Overgrowth start: the arena is 6 columns, 200 px wide. Note which one he is in.
On the right edge: column 5.
On the left edge: column 0.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.

Overgrowth wave: every WaveGap seconds, rain falls on every column but one. The gap starts at the far wall and moves one column toward him each wave, so the player has to follow it, or roll through a rain.
Create one rain per column.
Put each new rain on its column.
Remove the rain on this wave's gap column.
Mark this wave's rains as placed, and count the wave.
Overgrowth over: he is spent and open for OverOpenTime seconds.
Overgrowth punish window over: back to Neutral.
Between phases: after a second in the pose, phase 2 starts. Faster, with poison, the air volley and the beam.
Arrows: fly straight.
Arrow hit the player or was deflected. On a hit, entangle roots the player and poison poisons them. Either way it plays its hit.
It hit: an entangle arrow roots the player for RootTime seconds, with roots at their feet.
Arrow came from the left: roots facing right.
Arrow came from the right: roots facing left.
It hit: a poison arrow poisons the player for PoisonTime seconds, PoisonTick damage every half second.
Play its hit, facing the way it flew.
Left-facing arrow: left-facing hit.

Arrow reached a wall: it sticks there. A poison arrow leaves a poison cloud at the foot of the wall for PoisonLinger seconds. Any other arrow grows a thorn bush there for WallThornLife seconds, so the walls get more dangerous as the fight goes on.
Right-facing arrow sticks.
Left-facing arrow sticks.
Poison arrow: leave a lingering cloud.
Any other arrow: grow a thorn bush at the foot of the wall, facing into it.
Right wall: thorns facing right.
Left wall: thorns facing left.
Arrow: remove it once its hit has played.
Diagonal arrows: fly down and toward the player.
Diagonal arrow hit the player or was deflected in the air: it breaks.
Right-facing break.
Left-facing break.
Diagonal arrow reached the ground: a thorn bush grows there. It hurts the first time it is touched, for ThornLife seconds.
Right-facing bush.
Left-facing bush.
Thorn bush: count down, and remove it when its time is up.
Time is up.
Broken diagonal arrow: remove it once its break has played.
Snare: the player walks into an armed trap without rolling: it snaps shut and roots them for TrapRootTime seconds, which sets up the punish slide.
Right-facing snap.
Left-facing snap.
Snare: an attack or lunge that hits an armed trap cuts it, so it can be cleared instead of rolled over.
Snare: remove a cut trap when its pieces have fallen.
Snare: an armed trap that is never stepped on withers after TrapLife seconds.
Time is up.
Snare: remove a snapped trap when the player is free and its snap has played.
Roots: remove them once the player is free.
Lingering poison: standing in the cloud keeps the player poisoned.
Lingering poison: count down, then fade out.
Time is up: fade.
Poison cloud: remove it when it fades.
Hitboxes: count down and remove each when its time is up.
Time is up.

Neutral: switch him off.
Inactive: switch him back on.
Finish switching off, so the press above does not switch him straight back on.
